items.title: Admissions Closed Until August 2027
items.author: Administration
items.body: Admissions are currently closed. We will resume accepting applications for Nursery through Senior Secondary in August 2027. Please check back then or contact the school office for more information.

items.title: Updated School Uniform Supplier
items.author: Administration
items.body: Please note our approved uniform supplier has changed. Contact the school office for the updated details and fitting schedule.

items.title: GABECE & WASSCE Mock Exam Timetable Released
items.author: Academic Office
items.body: Mock examination timetables for Grade 9 and SSS3 students are now available from class teachers and the academic office.

items.title: Election break
items.author: Administration
items.body: This is to inform all students and members of staff  that the institution  will observe an election break to allow individuals to participate in the upcoming electoral process. Academic activities will be temporarily suspended from 4th December and will resume on Monday, 7th December 2026.
